cases.issue: `tracker sync` crashes with KeyError: 'due' when a task has no due date. Traceback ends in sync/merge.py line 88. Started after upgrading to 2.4.0.
Running `tracker push --debug` prints my full API token in plain text to the terminal and to ~/.tracker/debug.log. Anyone who can read the log can use my account.

Importing a CSV with 500 rows with `tracker import tasks.csv` reports success, but only 312 tasks exist afterwards. The rest are silently dropped and the original file is already moved to the archive folder.
When I pipe `tracker list` into grep, the output still contains ANSI color codes, so my grep patterns fail. Colors should turn off when stdout is not a terminal.
Please add recurring tasks, for example `tracker add "water plants" --every 3d`. Right now I re-create the same task by hand every few days.
It would help scripting if `tracker list` had a `--json` flag that prints tasks as JSON instead of the table.
Feature request: export tasks with due dates to an .ics file so they show up in my calendar app.
The README says to run `tracker init --path ~/tasks`, but the flag is actually `--dir`. The example fails with 'unknown option --path'.
The docs do not list the keys allowed in config.toml. I had to read the source to find `default_project` and `week_start`.
Is it safe to run `tracker sync` from two laptops against the same remote at the same time, or should I wait for one to finish?
Where does tracker store its database on disk? I want to include it in my backups.
What is the difference between `tracker archive` and `tracker delete`? Can archived tasks be restored?
